citation: Dewald, J. F., Meijer, A. M., Oort, F. J., Kerkhof, G. A., & Bögels, S. M. (2010). The influence of sleep quality, sleep duration and sleepiness on school performance in children and adolescents: A meta-analytic review. Sleep Medicine Reviews, 14(3), 179–189. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.smrv.2009.10.004
use: Supports a literature-based rationale for examining sleep variables and school performance.
boundary: The review does not make a single student's reported sleep duration a randomized exposure.

citation: Curcio, G., Ferrara, M., & De Gennaro, L. (2006). Sleep loss, learning capacity and academic performance. Sleep Medicine Reviews, 10(5), 323–337. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.smrv.2005.11.001
use: Provides background linking sleep loss with learning and academic performance.
boundary: Review evidence does not eliminate confounding in a new observational classroom sample.
